description: This file defines a PHP interface 'LoggerAwareInterface' which describes objects that can have a logger set on them. It declares a single method 'setLogger' that accepts a 'LoggerInterface' instance.

classes.name: LoggerAwareInterface
classes.description: An interface indicating that an implementing class can have a logger set on it.

methods.name: setLogger
methods.description: Sets a logger instance on the object; accepts a 'LoggerInterface' as a parameter.
